source.citation: Atkins, M., Bennett, D. G., Dawes, A. C., Glasser, F. P., Kindness, A., Read, D. (1992). A thermodynamic model for blended cements. Cement and Concrete Research 22, 497-502.

transcription.from: the published article (PDF), Table 2, p. 500, read on the page text
transcription.note: The values were typed into test/atkins1992_reference.jl before this file existed and agree with the article. Mixture 32 is ettringite with a C-S-H of nominal Ca/Si = 0.9 in CO2-free water at 25 C; the solution is the one analyzed after 6 months (the table also gives 10 weeks). The authors' own model is the row MODEL: AFt + 0.9 CSH.

mixture_32_Ca_Si.description: Nominal Ca/Si of the C-S-H of mixture 32.

mixture_32_pH.description: pH of the solution of mixture 32.

mixture_1_Ca.description: Calcium in the solution of mixture 1, ettringite with a C-S-H of Ca/Si = 1.7, after 6 months.

model_mixture_32_pH.description: pH the authors' own 1992 model gives for mixture 32.

mixture_32_solution.location: Table 2, p. 500, mixture 32: the solution analyzed after 6 months, and the authors' model

notes: The table reports sulfate as SO4; the element column names it S, which is what the test totals.
